name: Sabyasachi Chowdhury
bio: Sabyasachi Chowdhury (born 31 October 1985) is an Indian Bengali television actor who is known for portraying Bamakhyapa in the TV serial Mahapeeth Tarapeeth, which aired on Star Jalsha.

credits.title: Jadukar Satyacharan
credits.overview: Bengali film directed by Sayantan Ghosal based on the mystery-adventure by Himadri Kishore Dasgupta.

credits.title: Sadhak Bamakhyapa
credits.overview: Bamakhyapa, an Indian saint living in the 18th century, is a great devotee of Goddess Tara. Though he is against the unconventional orthodox temple practices, he uses his divine powers to help the needy.

credits.title: Rappa Roy & Full Stop Dot Com
credits.overview: First adaptation of the Bengali comic on film.
